scientific.integrity: The theorem is proved directly from false-twin necessity and an explicit two-pass forcing order on the canonical staircase twin classes. The polynomial follows by independent classwise counting. Established zero-forcing, chain/difference-graph, and zero-forcing-polynomial sources are credited separately.
limitations: Every canonical open-neighborhood twin class is required to have size at least two.
The exact exhaustive checker covers the stated subclass only through total order twelve and is a stress test rather than the infinite proof.
Targeted alias searches reduce but do not eliminate the possibility of an overlooked formula in older difference/Ferrers-graph literature.

title: Zero-forcing polynomials of chain graphs with no singleton twin class
